# 書道研究 臥龍会 / Garyukai — Japanese Calligraphy Institute

> Founded 1940 in Utsunomiya, Japan. Garyukai is a Japanese calligraphy (shodo) institute publishing the monthly journal "Garyu" (past its 1,850th issue), with ~130 chapters and ~2,000 members. Third-generation head: Taku Higano (日賀野 琢), a specialist in seal script (tensho) and clerical script (reisho); member of Nitten and standing director of the Yomiuri Shohokai. Services: custom calligraphy artwork, workshops & talks, and calligraphy experiences for visitors to Japan.
